scope: 171 distinct passenger BEV battery/drivetrain configurations across 139 nameplates and 9 markets, audited November 15, 2026.

high-nickel.label: High-Nickel (NMC / NCA / NCMA)
high-nickel.description: Ternary layered-oxide cathodes (NMC811, NMC622/712, NCA, GM NCMA). Highest gravimetric energy density for long-range and performance packs; relies on nickel and typically cobalt.

lfp.label: LFP (Lithium Iron Phosphate)
lfp.description: Olivine LiFePO4 cathode (CATL LFP, BYD Blade 1.0/2.0, Gotion, SVOLT). Zero nickel or cobalt, high thermal stability, long cycle life, and lower $/kWh cost.

lmfp.label: LMFP / M3P (Mn-Doped Phosphate)
lmfp.description: Lithium Manganese Iron Phosphate & CATL M3P/Shenxing manganese-graded phosphate cathodes (~4.1V plateau vs 3.2V LFP), lifting energy density ~15-20% without high-nickel cost.

na-ion.label: Sodium-Ion (Na-ion, Lithium-Free)
na-ion.description: Commercial lithium-free sodium-ion cells (CATL Naxtra 175 Wh/kg, HiNa layered oxide, Farasis pouch). Retains >90% capacity at -20°C and operates down to -40°C.

semi-solid.label: Semi-Solid State (Hybrid Electrolyte)
semi-solid.description: Oxide/polymer solid-liquid composite electrolyte (~90-95% solid content, <=5-10% liquid wetting agent) paired with high-Si or Li-rich anodes (QingTao Energy).
